candidate_includes: records, source pages and errata/callback witnesses, helper code/tests/results, report, full claim ledger, inventories
candidate_excludes: producer reasoning notes and reconciliation, prior evaluator verdicts, root confidence, other worker status/results summaries
acceptance_floor: No unreported omitted source unit or unsupported delivered claim; explicit source ambiguities may remain visible.
stalled_disposition: Retain uncertainty/withhold unsupported assertion, never call an unexamined omitted unit complete.
review_identity_limit: Fresh context of same model family; no claim of cross-family review, independent clinical cohort, expert adjudication or IV&V.
